g.text: Repeated evidence and standard controls on a frozen toy policy
Descriptive means on the same 1,256 failure-conditioned pairs; 128 rules, 3 fixed checkpoints.
Query costs exclude the separately charged source retries; not a robot or new-algorithm result.
